title: ALLSELECTED with no arguments, as a CALCULATE modifier, also gives the total of what the query selects

source.quote: ALLSELECTED without arguments can be used only as a CALCULATE or CALCULATETABLE modifier.
source.supports: the form used here is allowed

source.quote: ignoring any filters that might have been applied inside the query, but keeping filters that come from outside
source.supports: the group's own filter is removed, the selection of Bike and Lock stays

derivation: Bike 400, Lock 80 (see the sales model). With the filter of the current group removed and the selection kept, both rows show 400 + 80 = 480.
